{{Quote|Of the events that have transpired over the last year, there are many rumors and far fewer facts. Those rumors could all be dispelled by having an exact chronology of events created, and perhaps, in another generation or two, such a chronology could be made public. While we were a covert force fighting against the Empire, there was no questioning the need for stealth and secrecy. It was what kept us alive and allowed us to fight on against the Empire. Because of this secrecy we have defeated them in battle after battle.|New Republic Chief of State Mon Mothma, following Ysanne Isard's final flight from Coruscant|<ref name="X:KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
'''6 ABY''' was the sixth [[Standard year/Legends|year]] after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] in the [[Galactic Standard Calendar]].

==Events==
*The [[Cirra Mace]] resurfaced on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genesia]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] of the [[Expansion Region/Legends|Expansion Region]] after being stolen [[9 BBY/Legends|fifteen]] [[Standard year/Legends|years]] ago and was offered for sale on the [[Black market/Legends|underground market]] in [[Brenn]], the largest [[City/Legends|city]] on Genesia. Warriors of the [[Cirra]] [[akia]]&mdash;clan of the [[Aramandi]] [[Species/Legends|species]]&mdash; most uncharacteristically found off their [[Aram|homeworld]], thoroughly searched the city to find the mace, but were unsuccessful. Rumors claimed that the mace was sold to a [[Nalroni/Legends|Nalroni]] [[Merchant/Legends|merchant]], and since this incident the Nalroni were considered [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] by Cirra warriors.<ref name="Corellia Antilles">{{JournalCite|14|From the Files of Corellia Antilles}}</ref>
*[[Nom Anor]] entered [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].<ref name="Boba Fett: A Practical Man">''[[Boba Fett: A Practical Man]]''</ref>
*[[Grand Admiral/Legends|Grand Admiral]] [[Octavian Grant]] defected to the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]].<ref name="NewChrono">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>
*[[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] was reformed.<ref name="X:RS" />
*[[Neimoidia/Legends|Neimoidia]] was quarantined after a dangerous [[Virus|viral]] outbreak.
*[[ChoFï]] was elected to the [[New Republic Provisional Council]].
*[[Ebenn Q3 Baobab/Legends|Ebenn Q3 Baobab]] wrote his [[Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide (real-life book)|''Galactic Phrase Book & Travel Guide'']].
*The Empire abandoned [[Commenor/Legends|Commenor]], [[Cyrillia/Legends|Cyrillia]], [[Foundry/Legends|Foundry]] and [[Gyndine/Legends|Gyndine]].<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>
*End of the [[Krantian Civil War]].<ref name="GB">''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]''</ref>
**The [[Krant system/Legends|Krant system]] joined the New Republic.<ref name="GB" />
*The New Republic launched its [[Core Campaign|campaign]] to free [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="X:RS" /><ref name="Atlas" />
*The New Republic [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|took]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[Ysanne Isard]],<ref name="X:KT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref><ref name="Atlas" /> replacing the [[New Republic Provisional Council]] with the [[New Republic Senate/Legends|New Republic Senate]], [[New Republic General Ministry|General Ministry]], and the [[Court of Justice]], thus officially taking authority of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]].
